lines: Blessed be He who spoke so that the world came into
being, blessed be He who speaks and acts, blessed be He
who decrees and fulfils, blessed be He who has mercy on the
earth, blessed be He who has mercy on the creatures, blessed
be He who grants those that fear Him a good reward, blessed
be He who lives forever and exists for eternity, blessed be
the Redeemer and Deliverer, blessed be His Name. Blessed
art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, God the
merciful father who is praised by the mouth of His people,
extolled and glorified by the tongue of His devoted ones and
His servants. Through the songs of David Thy servant will
we praise Thee, O Lord our God, with songs of praise and
hymns will we magnify Thee, praise Thee and glorify Thee
and recall Thy Name and crown Thee as our King, our God,
unique and everlasting, the King whose great Name is extolled
and glorified for ever. Blessed art Thou, O Lord King cel-
ebrated in paeons of praise.

lines: (Chron. I. 16, 8.)
Thank the Lord, invoke His Name, proclaim His deeds
among the peoples. Sing to Him, play music to Him, tell of
all His wonders. Take pride in His holy Name; let the heart
of those who seek the Lord, rejoice. Search for the Lord and
His strength, seek His countenance constantly. Remember
His wonders which He has performed, His signs and the
judgments of His mouth. O seed of His servant Israel, sons
of Jacob His elect, He is the Lord our God, over the whole
earth are His judgments. Remember for ever His convenant,
the word which He has commanded for thousands of genera-
tions, which He contracted with Abraham and swore to Isaac.

lines: He established it as Law for Jacob, for Israel as an eternal
convenant, saying: To you will I give the land of Canaan
as the portion of your inheritance, though you are small in
number, few and strangers in it. They wandered from nation
to nation, from one kingdom to another people. He let no
man oppress them and rebuked kings because of them. Do not
touch my anointed ones, to my prophets do no harm. Sing
to the Lord, all the earth, proclaim from day to day His
salvation. Tell of His glory among the nations and among all
peoples of His wonders. For great is the Lord and most
renowned, and more awe-inspiring than all deities. For all
the deities of the peoples are idols — the Lord has made the
heavens. Splendour and beauty are before Him, might and
glory are in His place. Ascribe to the Lord, O families of the
peoples, ascribe to the Lord honour and might. Ascribe to
the Lord the glory of His Name, bring a gift and come before
Him, bow before the Lord in sacred adornment. Tremble
before Him, all the earth, though the world be firm and does
not totter. Let the heavens rejoice and the earth revel and
among the nations let them say: The Lord reigns. Let the sea
roar and the fullness of it, let the field and all that is in it be
joyful. Then will trees of the forest exult before the Lord
when He comes to judge the earth. Thank the Lord for He
is good, for His grace endures for ever. And say: Save us,
God of our salvation, and gather us and deliver us from the
nations, so that we may thank Thy holy Name and extol Thy
fame. Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, from eternity
to eternity. And the whole people said Amen and praised the
Lord. Extol the Lord our God and bow before His footstool,
for He is holy. Extol the Lord our God and bow before His
holy mountain, for holy is the Lord our God. He is compas-
sionate, grants atonement for guilt and does not destroy;
many a time does He avert His anger nor does He arouse the
whole of His wrath. Thou, O Lord, dost not withold Thy
compassion from me, Thy grace and Thy truth always protect
me. Remember Thy compassion, O Lord, and Thine acts of
kindness for they are from eternity. Ascribe might to God,

אָנֹכִי יְיָ אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ הַמַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶֽרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם הַרְחֶב־פִּֽיךָ
וַאֲמַלְאֵהוּ: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּֽכָה לּוֹ אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁייָ אֱלֹהָיו:
וַאֲנִי בְּחַסְדְּךָ בָטַֽחְתִּי יָגֵל לִבִּי בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ אָשִֽׁירָה לַייָ

בְּכָל־הָאָֽרֶץ יָצָא קַוָּם וּבִקְצֵה תֵבֵל מִלֵּֽיהֶם לַשֶּֽׁמֶשׁ שָׂם אֹֽהֶל

מִקְצֵה הַשָּׁמַֽיִם מוֹצָאוֹ וּתְקוּפָתוֹ עַל־קְצוֹתָם וְאֵין נִסְתָּר

Awe-inspiring art Thou, O God, from Thy sanctuary the God
of Israel. He gives might and strength to the people, blessed
be God. God of vengeance is the Lord, O God of vengeance,
appear. Arise, O Judge of the earth, render retribution to the
proud. Salvation is the Lord’s, may Thy blessing come upon
Thy people (Selah). The Lord of Hosts is with us, a refuge
for us is the God of Jacob (Selah). Lord of Hosts, fortunate
the man who trusts in Thee. O Lord, save; may the King
answer us on the day we call. Save Thy people and bless Thine
inheritance, pasture them and bear them for ever. Our soul
waits for the Lord, He is our help and our shield. For in Him
will our heart rejoice, for in His holy Name do we trust. Let
Thy grace, O Lord, be upon us just as we wait for Thee.
Show us, O Lord, Thy grace, and give us Thy salvation. Arise
to be our help and redeem us for the sake of Thy grace. I am
the Lord your God, who has brought you up from the land of
Egypt, open your mouth wide and I will fill it. Fortunate the
people to whem the like of this happens, fortunate the people
whose God is the Lord. And I trust in Thy grace, my heart
revels in Thy salvation, I sing to the Lord for He has treated
me well.
